note: The December 2024 compromise: format.yml runs on pull_request_target and hands two secrets to ultralytics/actions@main, which checked out the fork head and interpolated the branch name in a shell inside the action (invisible from this repository, so no pr_target fact can be proven here); the poisoned cache then reached publish.yml, which publishes to PyPI. From the workflow files the spec gives a High path through the mutable action into the secrets-holding format job, and a Critical path through the mutable PyPI publish action into the publishing job. The setup-python pip cache that carried the poison is not a structured cache in the IR, so the cache edge itself is out of reach.
